deprecatedReason: City Horizon no longer uses miniature, diorama, toy-like, dollhouse, squat or chibi presentation as a default art-direction goal.

migration.rule: Any agent, recipe, worker or Blender job that still references CH_TYCOON_MINIATURE_V1 must treat it as retired and use CH_STYLIZED_PRERENDER_V1 instead.
preserve: classic tycoon path logic and information-density lessons
remove: oversized windows or doors merely for toy-like readability
roof dominance merely to make a building feel like a miniature

note: This file remains only as a compatibility tombstone so old references fail toward the current contract instead of silently restoring the retired miniature direction.
